The verified claim c6 says the placebo result was directionally consistent with the estimate but not conventionally significant (p 0.182 across 11 units). The picture contradicts the source and overstates the limit. Use a construction that does not encode equality, e.g. the suite bar visibly above most units, with no numbers, or drop bar heights entirely.

story_review.reviewer_identity: storyboard-critic leaf, claude-opus-5-5 high effort, isolated read-only phone comparison assignment

blocking_defects.defect: Equal bar heights picture a null placebo result, against the 'directionally consistent' wording in claim c6.

story_review.one_viewing_summary: Cameras in a generic Houston Methodist cardiothoracic room log patient entry, draping and turnover on a clock record, and text the surgeon when the patient is draped. A hospital study card shows the suite line rising above other sites to about 25 more surgeries a month (7 percent, interval 8.3 to 41.0). A placebo test is stamped short of significance, the authors' card says associated not caused, and the rollout is bundled with other reviews in a company the hospital partly owns. The paper leaves turnover for future work, so the turnover question box stays blank.
story_review.opening_to_ending: The opening asks whether logging cameras add surgeries or only count them. The ending returns to the same room and lamps with a dashed associated link to about 25 more cases and a blank turnover box. It answers 'a rise was measured, not shown to be caused' without inventing an outcome. The opening image itself (an abstract plan) does not yet pose the question visually.
story_review.weakest_transition: s6 to s7 at about 36.7 s: the crooked stamp is lifted and cut away after about 0.5 s, so the move from 'test short of significance' to 'associated, not caused' loses its readable bridge; the rollout tag then appears alone on a blank page.

notes: Sampled-image basis only: no MP4 playback, no listening, no audio or caption-sync judgment; motion between 0.2 s samples is unresolved. Region is correct: Harris County with a gulf-houston skyline-and-bayou window plate. All on-screen numerals (25, 7%, 95%, 8.3, 41.0) appear in the c5 quote. The Illustration disclosure stays visible. The 'Patient draped' message text is an illustrated stand-in, since the paper does not show the message text; acceptable under the persistent disclosure. Non-blocking notes: the phone shows a To surgeon header before draping, but the body stays blank until after the drape (13.0-15.8 s); camera status lamps are a few pixels at phone size (4.0-4.8 s); the struck caused arrow and dashed link originate off-frame once the tag is cropped (40.4-42.4 s); the band hides the rollout tag label (44.8-45.8 s); the question-box heading collides with the wall camera (54.4-56.6 s); b shows an empty ledger page at 46.0-46.2 and 50.4-50.6 s. One consolidated correction for b: open on a recognizable performed room image; redraw the placebo row so it does not encode equality and honours 'directionally consistent'; give the stamp result a hold of about 1 s or more before the cut; keep the rollout tag in frame for the struck arrow; let the bundle band wrap the tag and notes without hiding the tag label; clear the camera from the question-box heading.
